input: Overreliance and unsafe use is a risk associated with An e-commerce platform's recommendation system is designed to suggest products to users based on their browsing and purchasing history. It aims to provide personalized shopping experiences by identifying frequently bought-together items and promoting relevant products. The system's goal is to help users discover new products and streamline their shopping process.
